feat(codeon): expose System|Named runtime_source on issue API/MCP

HTTP issue projections and MCP create/replace now carry explicit
runtime_source (system|named) with optional runtime_profile. Omitted
source keeps the historical rule; inconsistent pairs fail closed.
Named("default") is not rewritten to System. MCP required stays ["kind"].

Co-authored-by: fewensa <fewensa@users.noreply.github.com>
